## The problem

What are you trying to do that Aether makes hard or impossible today?

## The proposal

What should change? Keep it specific enough to discuss.

## Does it touch trust boundaries?

Check any that apply:

- [ ] It adds a new outbound action or connected app
- [ ] It changes authorization, approvals, or audit
- [ ] It sends data to a new third party
- [ ] It changes encryption or secret storage
- [ ] It adds a background job or sandbox path

If any are checked, describe how the change stays deterministic, auditable, and within
the existing policy gate.

## Alternatives

What have you tried or considered?
